New this cycle: four more routines of the integer library that Nethermind's next release pins were transcribed and match on 756,689 cases, six builds that no earlier cycle reached (erigon 3.6.0, 3.7.0 and 3.7.1, Geth 1.17.5-9621c6ad and 1.17.7, and a Go node that names itself sentio-super-node) ran the 200,127 vectors with no mismatch, and the evm2 revision on reth main was read against the release.

deltas.delta: Nethermind's release/2.3.0 branch exists and pins Nethermind.Numerics.Int256 1.15.0, as the 2.3.0-rc tag does. Tag 2.3.0 does not exist yet (raw file 404). The interpreter files that hold the PoolManager's arithmetic, shift, jump analysis, storage, stack and dispatch code are byte equal between 2.3.0-rc and release/2.3.0. master has moved to 2.4.0-preview, still pins Int256 1.15.0, and differs only in tracing and gas-tracing arguments in ControlFlow, Storage, Stack and a visibility change in JumpDestinationAnalyzer. NuGet lists no Int256 release after 1.15.0.

reth main still reads version 2.11.0 and no tag after v2.11.0 exists (v2.11.1, v2.11.2, v2.12.0, v2.12.0-rc.1 return 404). reth main pins evm2 e80df9c4, which carries evm2 7c9f3b6d's evm/mod.rs (nested transaction dispatch), memory.rs (100 MiB per-frame memory limit), host.rs (SSTORE skips the cold load below ColdStorageCost instead of ColdStorageAdditionalCost), system.rs (call gas refactor) and version/mod.rs byte for byte, and in arithmetic.rs replaces the zero checks of DIV and MOD with ruint checked_div and checked_rem. The release reth v2.11.0 runs evm2 66687c18, which has none of these.

cleared.check: Lead L-1232: MulModBy128Bits (with Remainder128By128Bits, Remainder256By128Bits, Mul128 and KnuthStep), Remainder512By192Bits (with EstimateQhat, SubMulTo3 and AddTo3), DivideBy192Bits (with AddBack3 and Sub) and DivideBy128BitsX86Base from Nethermind.Numerics.Int256 1.15.0, transcribed line by line into Python and run against Python integers, in both the x86 DivRem arm and the reciprocal arm. Operands follow the PoolManager's shapes: moduli near 2^96 (MULMOD at FullMath.sol:48 and :112 for mulDiv by Q96, SqrtPriceMath.sol:97 and :105, :250), 2^128 and its neighbours (Position.sol:94 and :96 by Q128), sqrt prices from 4295128739 to 1461446703485210103287273052203988822378723970342 as divisors (SqrtPriceMath.sol:47, :71, :208-209), up to 2^192 - 1, words shifted by 32 to 96 bits, plus hard cases built as q times d plus a small r with a divisor whose low limbs are near all ones.
cleared.result: 756,689 cases (about 100,000 per routine and arm), no mismatch. The rare branches ran: 65,504 KnuthStep add-back corrections, 508 saturated KnuthStep digits, 1,308 inline add-backs and 106,556 full multiply-subtract steps in Remainder512By192Bits, 364 and 494 add-backs in the two DivideBy192Bits digits, 374 second qhat corrections and 12,328 zero low limb fast paths in DivideBy128BitsX86Base, and 86,490 skips of the zero leading digit. Two branches were never reached: the CorrectStep after a saturated KnuthStep digit and the add-back after a saturated digit in Remainder512By192Bits; both need a quotient digit two too high, which Knuth's bound allows only for unnormalised remainders the callers do not build. Planted faults: dropping the KnuthStep add-back gave 36,362 mismatches, testing the zero digit skip with <= gave 22, dropping the inline add-back gave 396, and dropping the second correction in DivideBy128BitsX86Base hit the hardware divide fault (the precondition assert). Dropping the second correction in the first DivideBy192Bits digit and the saturated add-back were not caught, since the single add-back covers the first and the second is unreached. Nethermind 2.3.0 final is not tagged; release/2.3.0 pins Int256 1.15.0, the version transcribed.

cleared.result: bitwise.rs, i256.rs, control.rs, the memory instructions, interpreter/mod.rs, bytecode/analysis.rs and state/storage.rs are byte equal in all three. arithmetic.rs writes a.checked_div(b).unwrap_or_default() and a.checked_rem(b).unwrap_or_default() for DIV and MOD; in ruint 1.21.1, the version both reth main and v2.11.0 lock, checked_div and checked_rem return None for a zero divisor and otherwise call the same div and rem that wrapping_div and wrapping_rem use, so the results are those of the release. The per-frame memory limit of 100 MiB needs about 2 x 10^10 gas of expansion, far above the 60 million block gas limit. The SSTORE cold load threshold only decides whether a frame that runs out of gas loads the slot first; the frame fails either way and its access set rolls back. src passes gas() to every call and never reads gas otherwise (Currency.sol:48, Hooks.sol:134).

cleared.check: Lead L-1245, second part: does reth itself start a transaction while another one is running, the path that evm2 7c9f3b6d's suspended_frames and enclosing_refund now handle?
cleared.result: evm2 e80df9c4 treats a transaction as nested only when Evm::running is set, for example one started from an inspector hook (evm/mod.rs lines 1399-1420). In reth main, prewarm calls transact_and_discard and transact_with_inspector on the worker's own EVM (prewarm.rs lines 374 and 415), and its only inspector, BalanceTracker, implements step, call, call_end and create and starts no transaction (reuse.rs lines 1022-1080). RPC eth_call, simulate, callMany and access list creation call transact or transact_with_inspector at the top level (rpc-eth-api helpers/call.rs lines 244, 290, 405, 515). No caller read starts a transaction inside a running one, so the new path is not reached on an Ethereum reth node for block validation or RPC. The payload builder crate (crates/ethereum/payload/src/lib.rs) contains no direct transact call; its executor path was not read.

leadResults.answer: Done for Int256 1.15.0. MulModBy128Bits, Remainder512By192Bits, DivideBy192Bits and DivideBy128BitsX86Base were transcribed with their helpers in both arms and gave no mismatch on 756,689 cases with the PoolManager's moduli (near 2^96, near 2^128, sqrt prices, up to 2^192 - 1) and hard add-back cases; four of six planted faults were caught and the other two sit on branches the inputs never reach. Nethermind 2.3.0 final is not tagged; release/2.3.0 and master pin Int256 1.15.0, and NuGet has no later Int256. A new low lead asks for a recheck when 2.3.0 is tagged. Operator level only.

93 keyless Ethereum endpoints were asked on 2026-11-27, 61 of them from chainlist.org. None names Nethermind or Besu. Six builds not reached before did run the full vector set (erigon 3.6.0 behind a gateway, erigon 3.7.0, erigon 3.7.1, Geth 1.17.5-9621c6ad, Geth 1.17.7, sentio-super-node), with no mismatch.

No reth release after v2.11.0 exists. reth main pins evm2 e80df9c4, which holds 7c9f3b6d's evm/mod.rs byte for byte, so the next reth release from main will carry the nested dispatch change to Ethereum nodes; which version number it will have is not known. No reth caller read (prewarm, speculative reuse, RPC call and simulate) starts a transaction inside a running one, so the changed path is not reached on Ethereum; the payload builder's executor path was not read. The other evm2 changes on main keep the specified results.
